notes: North American native mint-family perennial. Earl Grey tea aroma. Pollinator powerhouse. Hardy to zone 4.
harvestIndicators: Flower spikes fully open, fragrant when crushed

seasonalTasks.title: Divide bee balm every 2 to 3 years
seasonalTasks.body: In early spring, as the shoots come up, dig and divide the clumps to control their spread and renew the plants.

seasonalTasks.title: Remove bee balm debris in fall
seasonalTasks.body: Clear away and destroy diseased leaves and stems in fall, since powdery mildew survives the winter on them.
